verdict.rationale: Chronicle's documented evaluation model runs scorers against frozen task suites in simulated environments. Production data is mainly turned into replayed tests, which is offline evaluation. The only production-facing pieces are telemetry ingestion from the agent process via SDK or OpenTelemetry, and a marketing claim of real-time monitoring of production agents; neither shows scorers running continuously on live traffic. Missing for 10: documented online/continuous scorer execution on live production traces, sampling or scheduling controls for production evals, hands-on or independent corroboration.
